title: Parametric constraints, associative drafting, and advanced 2D editing
objective: Complete the next bounded professional-CAD editing layer with deterministic, engine-independent constraints, associative drafting, reusable 2D symbols/blocks, and deterministic mirror/array/pattern operations while preserving the frozen CADDocument/App API/Construction Graph architecture.
acceptance_criteria: A representative constrained 2D drawing can be created and deterministically solved through the shared App API.
Constraint edits propagate to dependent geometry and associative dimensions/annotations without breaking canonical identities.
Unsatisfied, over-constrained, ambiguous, and unsupported cases fail explicitly and reproducibly.
Block/symbol definitions can produce multiple instances with stable definition/instance relationships.
Mirror/array operations produce deterministic identities and remain replayable.
Save/open preserves constraints, symbols, associations, and revision lineage.
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic results through their real transports.
Existing 2D drafting, BIM, IFC, documentation, real-engine, and governance suites remain green.
No direct OCCT/FreeCAD/IfcOpenShell imports are introduced into renderer/CADDocument/App API.
No protected architecture files are modified.
non_goals: Advanced 3D parametric assemblies or MEP/structural constraints.
Approval or verification claim by implementation.
risk_assumptions: Issue #65 is authoritative for scope; the implementation is additive under frozen Architecture v1.1.
There is no dedicated constraints requirement ID in the frozen requirements registry; the slice is mapped to CAD-001/CAD-002/BIM-002 and the issue is authoritative.
The constraint solver is intentionally bounded and deterministic. Unsupported relationships decline explicitly rather than being approximated.
Construction Graph identity remains canonical-element keyed; constraints and associations never promote engine-native IDs to identity.
Reusable block definitions follow the canonical definition/instance identity pattern established by COMPAT-BIM-003.
AutoCAD/Archicad parity is a later product program and is not claimed by this work item.

transitions.reason: Issue #65 defines the next bounded CAD editing layer after the verified BIM foundation.
COMPAT-BIM-003 is formally VERIFIED on main; the dependency gate is clear and execution is released.
Implementation begins from main 161d0284 with all declared foundations verified.

evidence_requirements: Deterministic constraint tests covering supported geometric and dimensional relationships plus explicit failure classifications.
Associative annotation/dimension recomputation evidence keyed by canonical element identities.
Block/symbol definition-instance and mirror/array/pattern determinism evidence.
Immutable revision, replay, undo/redo and save/open preservation evidence.
Web/Electron parity through their real transports.
All existing CAD/BIM/IFC/documentation and governance regression suites remain green.
